numericFindings.finding: 2018 nationwide protected tomato production 約56.2万t is retained as 约56.2万吨 / 約56.2萬噸, equivalent to approximately 562,000 tonnes. Protected-production scope and separate cultivated-area ranking remain explicit.

2018 nationwide protected strawberry production 約13.5万t is retained as 约13.5万吨 / 約13.5萬噸, equivalent to approximately 135,000 tonnes, including the example record. Neither locale recasts it as current or all-method production.

The yield denominator 10a is rendered as 每10公亩 in zh-CN and 每10a in zh-TW, preserving exactly ten ares. Heading, paragraph and activity distinguish declining area from rising yield per this area; no trend comparison years or rates are invented.

1年以上 includes one year and longer. Both paragraphs retain some fertilizers as the source-scoped example and deny a common guaranteed duration for all actual products; activities retain the example scope.

reviewFindings: Read all six Japanese lessons and independently compared all 180 fields across 12 pairs, including each title, objective, activity, six paragraph titles and six paragraph bodies. This was a semantic review, not merely script conversion.

Both locales preserve 硝安 as the abbreviation for ammonium nitrate and one fertilizer rather than two, and preserve many blends containing organic fertilizer as frequency rather than high organic proportion or a universal ingredient definition.

Both locales preserve microbial decomposition versus chemical poor solubility, separate pellet shape from ingredients, restrict ABA teaching to seed dormancy, and retain ethylene flowering promotion and suppression.

Both locales preserve selective/non-selective affected-plant scope separately from uptake/application route, retain already-large-weed effectiveness limits, and distinguish equipment residues from outward drift without introducing product-use permissions.

Both locales preserve cabbage form and summer-region distinctions, Chinese cabbage cooking versus calendar, lettuce curled form versus transplantation, spinach breeding and year-round cultivation without one-plant continuous harvest, and onion edible-part versus transplant method.

Both locales preserve source-attributed regulator purposes, Unshu mandarin specificity, generic pear scope without narrowing to Japanese pears, preharvest timing, many-fruit-tree scope, and self-propelled versus ride-on type.
